reason: I only pay when the thing is in my hand. Here I have to send the item price and the fee before anything happens, to a new page I've never heard of, and my cousin already lost a deposit exactly like that.
objection: Paying up front to a new service that could disappear, and then waiting 2 to 3 weeks hoping something shows up. Also 13,000 a kilo makes the small cheap things I want not worth it.
would_change_my_mind: Full cash on delivery, I pay nothing until it arrives, or friends I know who already got their orders from them.
